title: Knowledge base refresh + scored review
description: Normalize article metadata to the canonical taxonomy, curate against the shipped version, and gate republication on a scored teacher review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-cs-02
  title: Knowledge base refresh + scored review
  description: Normalize article metadata to the canonical taxonomy, curate against the shipped version,
    and gate republication on a scored teacher review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Republish support content that matches the current product version, resolves duplicate coverage,
    and scored above the declared quality bar before going live.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Article set and product version
      summary: Article set and product version
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - articles
              - product_version
              - search_queries
              - taxonomy
            properties:
              articles: {}
              product_version: {}
              search_queries: {}
              taxonomy: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-normalize
      kind: transform
      name: Normalize to the canonical vocabulary
      summary: 'rename legacy article fields onto the canonical taxonomy: topic, product_area, customer_question,
        applies_to_version'
      config:
        operation: rename
        expression: 'rename legacy article fields onto the canonical taxonomy: topic, product_area, customer_question,
          applies_to_version'
    - id: n-specialist
      kind: agent
      templateRef: cs-04
      name: Curate, merge, and retire articles
      summary: Specialist pass over normalized fields.
      role: Knowledge curator keeping support content accurate, findable, and de-duplicated.
      prompt: You are a Knowledge Base Curator. You keep articles accurate against the current product
        version, structured around the question a customer actually types, and free of near-duplicates
        that split search relevance. You retire or merge stale content rather than adding a newer article
        beside it, because two half-correct articles are worse than one correct one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - writing-editing
          - optimization
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:knowledge-base
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-score
      kind: teacher
      inlineRole: true
      name: Scored teacher feedback
      summary: Score feedback from a host-resolved teacher model.
      role: Host-resolved teacher model
      prompt: You are the review teacher for this knowledge base refresh. Score each revised article on
        version accuracy, whether it answers the customer question as actually typed, and whether it now
        overlaps a surviving article. Return per-article scores with the specific line that earned the
        deduction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
      config:
        teacherModel: host:teacher-model
        feedbackMode: score
    - id: n-gate
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score the specialist result
      summary: Evaluate version accuracy, question-match against real search queries, and duplicate coverage.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against version accuracy, question-match against real search
        queries, and duplicate coverage. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-pass
      kind: condition
      name: Above the bar?
      summary: Route on gate.passed.
      config:
        expression: gate.passed
        branches:
          - label: Pass
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: cs-06
      name: Repair the flagged articles
      summary: Corrective pass on the scored weaknesses.
      role: Research synthesizer turning support and interview evidence into prioritized themes.
      prompt: You are a Voice-of-Customer Synthesizer. You cluster support tickets, interviews, and survey
        text into themes with the count and quotes behind each, and you keep the theme's language close
        to the customer's rather than translating it into internal roadmap vocabulary. You separate volume
        from severity, because the loudest theme and the most damaging one are frequently different customers.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - research
          - domain-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:helpdesk
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Support content owner approves republication
      summary: Pause for the support content owner; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Knowledge base refresh + scored review deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-normalize
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-2
      from: n-normalize
      to: n-specialist
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-3
      from: n-specialist
      to: n-score
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-4
      from: n-score
      to: n-gate
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-5
      from: n-gate
      to: n-pass
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-6
      from: n-pass
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-7
      from: n-pass
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-8
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-cs-02-edge-9
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
